sources.title: S-JVF02 SMT Stick Vibration Feeder Operation Manual Rev. 2025
S-JVF02 product landing page, §03 spec table
RS-1 Vibration Feeder S-JVF02 3D drawings (4 pages)
S-JVF02 Vibration Stick Feeder RS-1.wav (marketing audio, no specs used)

zh.criterion: 无划伤、磕碰、变形、锈蚀；表面处理均匀无脱落；非可视面划痕 ≤ 5 mm 且 ≤ 2 处
zh.method: 目视，照度 ≥ 500 lx，距离 30 - 50 cm

en.criterion: No scratches, dents, deformation or rust; finish even, no peeling; scratches on non-visible faces ≤ 5 mm and ≤ 2

question.zh: 外观划痕允收标准（≤5 mm 且 ≤2 处）是否采用？
question.en: Accept scratch limit (≤5 mm, ≤2) as standard?

zh.method: 钢直尺 / 游标卡尺测量长、宽、高
zh.source: 产品页 §03 规格表 'Overall size'

en.criterion: 365 × 66 × 125 mm, tolerance ± 1 mm
en.method: Steel rule / caliper, measure L × W × H

question.zh: 外形尺寸公差 ±1 mm 是否正确？
question.en: Is ±1 mm the right dimension tolerance?

zh.criterion: 6.5 kg，公差 ± 0.2 kg
zh.method: 电子秤称重（不含料管）

en.criterion: 6.5 kg, tolerance ± 0.2 kg

question.zh: 重量公差 ±0.2 kg 是否正确？
question.en: Is ±0.2 kg the right weight tolerance?

zh.criterion: 型号 S-JVF02、序列号、24 V DC / 15 W 清晰牢固；为 Southern Machinery 标识，无其他厂商标识
zh.method: 目视；用无尘布擦拭 10 次不脱落
zh.source: 产品页 §03 规格表；品牌规则 smt-brand-kit

en.criterion: Model S-JVF02, serial no., 24 V DC / 15 W legible and fixed; Southern Machinery marking only, no other maker's marks
en.method: Visual; wipe 10 times with lint-free cloth, no fading
en.source: Product page §03 spec table; smt-brand-kit brand rules

zh.criterion: 主体、顶板、前盖、导轨、支撑架、手柄、控制单元齐全，与手册第 9 章 14 项零件清单一致
zh.method: 对照零件清单 S-JVF02-052801 ~ 052814 逐项核对
zh.source: 手册 §9 p.12 零件清单

en.criterion: Main body, top plate, front cover, guide rail, support frame, handlebar and control unit present, matching the 14-item list in Manual Ch. 9
en.method: Check item by item against parts S-JVF02-052801 ~ 052814

zh.criterion: 料道、取料区及内部无金属屑、油污、异物
zh.method: 目视 + 无尘布擦拭

en.criterion: Lanes, pick-up area and interior free of metal chips, oil and foreign matter

zh.criterion: 螺丝无缺失、无滑牙，全部紧固并点防松标记；M3 扭矩 0.5 - 0.7 N·m
zh.method: 扭力螺丝刀抽检 ≥ 5 颗；目视防松标记

en.criterion: No missing or stripped screws; all tightened with torque-seal mark; M3 torque 0.5 - 0.7 N·m
en.method: Torque screwdriver, sample ≥ 5 screws; visual check of marks

question.zh: M3 螺丝扭矩 0.5–0.7 N·m 是否与装配工艺一致？
question.en: Does M3 torque 0.5–0.7 N·m match the assembly spec?

zh.criterion: 手柄抬起 / 放下顺畅无卡滞，释放后可靠复位锁紧
zh.method: 手动操作 10 次

en.criterion: Handlebar raises and lowers smoothly, no binding; returns and locks when released

zh.criterion: 定位销（S-JVF02-052807）无松动、无变形，与飞达座定位孔配合顺畅
zh.method: 手感检查 + 装机测试

en.criterion: Locating pin (S-JVF02-052807) not loose or bent; enters the feeder bank alignment hole smoothly

zh.criterion: 连接器（S-JVF02-052814）针脚无弯曲、缩针、氧化，安装牢固
zh.method: 放大镜目视

en.criterion: Connector (S-JVF02-052814) pins not bent, recessed or oxidised; firmly mounted

zh.criterion: 按手册 4.1 / 4.2 步骤装入 JUKI RS-1 飞达座（或等效测试座）：插入顺畅，锁定后无可感晃动（≤ 0.2 mm）；拆卸顺畅
zh.method: 实装 / 拆卸 5 次；百分表或手感

en.criterion: Install in JUKI RS-1 feeder bank (or equivalent test bank) per Manual 4.1 / 4.2: smooth insertion, no perceptible play once locked (≤ 0.2 mm); smooth removal
en.method: Install / remove 5 times; dial gauge or hand check

question.zh: 锁定后晃动 ≤0.2 mm 是否采用？
question.en: Accept ≤0.2 mm play when locked?

zh.criterion: 弹簧（S-JVF02-052806）无变形，回弹正常
zh.method: 目视 + 手压

en.criterion: Spring (S-JVF02-052806) not deformed, rebounds normally

zh.criterion: 在飞达座 2 个不同槽位均可正常装入并锁定
zh.method: 实装测试

en.criterion: Installs and locks in 2 different feeder bank slots

question.zh: 是否需要 2 个槽位互换测试？
question.en: Is a 2-slot interchange test required?

sections.zh: 飞达供料与振动 / 皮带机构

zh.criterion: 4 条独立料道齐全；导轨（S-JVF02-052810）平行、无毛刺、无变形；66 mm 料管可顺畅放入
zh.method: 目视；用 66 mm 标准料管试装每条料道
zh.source: 产品页 §03 规格表 'Input channels / Stick width'；手册 §9 #13

en.criterion: 4 independent lanes present; guide rail (S-JVF02-052810) parallel, no burrs or deformation; 66 mm tube fits each lane smoothly
en.method: Visual; trial-fit a standard 66 mm tube in each lane
en.source: Product page §03 'Input channels / Stick width'; Manual §9 #13

zh.criterion: 定位环（后）、板簧（中）、定位块（前）可将料管可靠固定；板簧对料管有下压力
zh.method: 装入料管后手推，料管无窜动

en.criterion: Locating ring (rear), leaf spring (middle) and locating piece (front) hold the tube securely; leaf spring presses down on the tube
en.method: Push the fitted tube by hand: no movement

zh.criterion: 振动器（S-JVF02-052809）安装牢固；通电振动均匀，无异响、无碰撞声
zh.method: 通电听音、手感

en.criterion: Vibrator (S-JVF02-052809) firmly mounted; even vibration when powered, no abnormal or knocking noise

zh.criterion: 全行程转动顺畅；振动强度由最小到最大连续可调
zh.method: 旋钮从最小转到最大，观察振幅变化

en.criterion: Turns smoothly through full travel; vibration strength adjusts continuously from min to max
en.method: Turn from min to max, observe amplitude

zh.criterion: 全行程转动顺畅；振动频率连续可调，可找到元件平稳输送点
zh.method: 旋钮从最小转到最大，观察元件流动

en.criterion: Turns smoothly through full travel; vibration frequency adjusts continuously, a smooth-flow point can be found
en.method: Turn from min to max, observe component flow

zh.criterion: 3 × 3 mm 元件：调试后元件平稳、连续送至取料位，无卡料、跳料、翻转；每条料道连续 ≥ 100 pcs
zh.method: 每条料道装料管，计数观察
zh.source: 产品页 §03 'Component size range'；数量 G-RUN-01

en.criterion: 3 × 3 mm parts: after tuning, parts move smoothly and continuously to the pick-up position, no jam, jump or flip; ≥ 100 pcs per lane
en.method: Load a tube in each lane, count and observe
en.source: Product page §03 'Component size range'; qty G-RUN-01

question.zh: 小元件送料测试每料道 ≥100 pcs 是否合适？
question.en: Is ≥100 pcs per lane right for the small-part test?

zh.criterion: 30 × 10 mm 元件：同上，每条料道连续 ≥ 50 pcs
zh.method: 每条料道装料管，计数观察
zh.source: 产品页 §03 'Component size range'；数量 G-RUN-01

en.criterion: 30 × 10 mm parts: as above, ≥ 50 pcs per lane
en.method: Load a tube in each lane, count and observe
en.source: Product page §03 'Component size range'; qty G-RUN-01

question.zh: 大元件送料测试每料道 ≥50 pcs 是否合适？
question.en: Is ≥50 pcs per lane right for the large-part test?

zh.criterion: 料管顶面在取料区按要求切开；元件停在取料位高度一致、姿态稳定
zh.method: 目视 / 塞尺检查高度差 ≤ 0.2 mm ★

en.criterion: Tube top face cut at the nozzle pick-up area; parts stop at a consistent height and attitude
en.method: Visual / feeler gauge, height difference ≤ 0.2 mm ★

question.zh: 取料位高度差 ≤0.2 mm 是否采用？
question.en: Accept ≤0.2 mm pick-height difference?

zh.criterion: 4 条料道各自独立供料；一条料道空料或换料时其余料道不受影响
zh.method: 逐条取出料管观察其他料道

en.criterion: Each of the 4 lanes feeds independently; emptying or changing one lane does not disturb the others
en.method: Remove tubes one by one, observe other lanes

zh.criterion: 4 条料道满载连续运行 ≥ 2 h：无卡料、无停振；外壳温升 ≤ 20 K
zh.method: 计时；红外测温枪测振动器附近外壳

en.criterion: All 4 lanes loaded, continuous run ≥ 2 h: no jams, no vibration stop; housing temperature rise ≤ 20 K
en.method: Timer; IR thermometer on housing near vibrator

question.zh: 连续运行 ≥2 h、温升 ≤20 K 是否采用？
question.en: Accept ≥2 h run and ≤20 K temperature rise?

zh.criterion: 常用设定下距飞达 1 m 处噪音 ≤ 70 dB(A)
zh.method: 声级计（A 计权），背景噪音低于测量值 ≥ 10 dB

en.criterion: At normal setting, measured 1 m from the feeder: ≤ 70 dB(A)
en.method: Sound level meter (A-weighted), background ≥ 10 dB below reading

question.zh: 噪音 ≤70 dB(A) @1 m 是否采用？
question.en: Accept ≤70 dB(A) at 1 m?

zh.criterion: 在 JUKI RS-1 上取料 ≥ 500 次，取料成功率 ≥ 99.5 %
zh.method: 读取设备取料 / 抛料记录

en.criterion: On JUKI RS-1, ≥ 500 picks, pick success ≥ 99.5 %
en.sampling: First unit per lot (if RS-1 available)

question.zh: 工厂是否有 JUKI RS-1 做实机取料测试？成功率 ≥99.5 % 是否采用？
question.en: Is a JUKI RS-1 available for pick tests? Accept ≥99.5 %?

zh.criterion: S-JVF02 为振动式供料，无皮带机构，本项判 NA
zh.method: 核对结构

en.criterion: S-JVF02 is vibration feeding with no belt mechanism; record NA

zh.criterion: 开关打开且飞达锁定后指示灯亮；关闭开关或未锁定时熄灭
zh.method: 通电操作开关 / 手柄

en.criterion: Lamp on when the feeder is switched on and locked; off when switched off or not locked
en.method: Operate switch / handlebar with power on

zh.criterion: 开关通断明确；关闭后振动立即停止
zh.method: 操作 10 次

en.criterion: Switch on/off positive; vibration stops immediately when off

zh.criterion: 装入 RS-1 后设备正常识别飞达，无飞达或连接报警
zh.method: 实机装入，查看设备界面

en.criterion: After installation, RS-1 recognises the feeder with no feeder or connection alarm
en.method: Install on machine, check machine screen

question.zh: RS-1 识别飞达是否需要额外设置？无报警作为判定是否可行？
question.en: Does RS-1 need any setting to recognise the feeder? Is 'no alarm' the right criterion?

zh.item: 光电 / 料有无传感器
zh.criterion: 手册未列出光电传感器；若该批次配置，遮光 / 放料时信号与指示正确；未配置判 NA
zh.method: 遮光片 / 元件遮挡测试

en.criterion: Not listed in Manual; if fitted on this batch, signal and indication correct when blocked / part present; NA if not fitted

question.zh: S-JVF02 是否配置光电 / 料有无传感器？若有，型号和判定方式？
question.en: Is a photoelectric / part-presence sensor fitted? If so, which and how to judge?

zh.criterion: 走线整齐、扎带固定，无挤压、无破皮，远离振动部件
zh.method: 打开前盖目视

en.criterion: Neatly routed and tied, not pinched or damaged, clear of vibration parts

sections.zh: 电气与安全（接地、绝缘、急停）

zh.method: 万用表在连接器电源针测量

en.criterion: 24 V DC at connector, allowed 21.6 - 26.4 V (± 10 %)

question.zh: 供电允许范围 ±10 % 是否正确？
question.en: Is ±10 % the right supply range?

zh.criterion: 额定 15 W；24 V 最大振动设定下电流 ≤ 0.65 A（≈ 15.6 W）
zh.method: 直流钳形表 / 可调电源读数
zh.source: 产品页 §03 'Power'；电流按 15 W/24 V 推算

en.criterion: Rated 15 W; at 24 V and max vibration setting current ≤ 0.65 A (≈ 15.6 W)
en.method: DC clamp meter / bench supply reading
en.source: Product page §03 'Power'; current derived from 15 W/24 V

question.zh: 最大电流上限 0.65 A 是否采用？
question.en: Accept 0.65 A max current?

zh.criterion: 电源极性与连接器定义一致；上电无冒烟、异味、发热异常
zh.method: 上电观察 5 min

en.criterion: Polarity matches connector pin-out; no smoke, smell or abnormal heat at power-on

zh.criterion: 金属主体与连接器接地针之间电阻 ≤ 0.1 Ω
zh.method: 低电阻测试仪 / 微欧表

en.criterion: Resistance between metal body and connector ground pin ≤ 0.1 Ω

question.zh: 接地电阻 ≤0.1 Ω 是否采用？连接器哪一针为地？
question.en: Accept ≤0.1 Ω? Which connector pin is ground?

zh.criterion: 电源针（短接）对金属外壳 ≥ 1 MΩ，测试电压 250 V DC（参照 IEC 60204-1，24 V 低压回路）
zh.method: 绝缘电阻表，断开控制单元电子元件后测试
zh.source: 通用标准 G-ELE-05（参照 IEC 60204-1）

en.criterion: Power pins (shorted) to metal housing ≥ 1 MΩ at 250 V DC (ref. IEC 60204-1, 24 V circuit)
en.method: Insulation tester, control unit electronics isolated

question.zh: 绝缘测试 250 V DC / ≥1 MΩ 是否采用？
question.en: Accept 250 V DC / ≥1 MΩ insulation test?

zh.criterion: 飞达本体无急停；装在 RS-1 上按下设备急停后，设备停止动作，飞达振动停止或进入安全状态
zh.method: 实机按急停测试

en.criterion: Feeder has no own E-stop; with RS-1 E-stop pressed, machine stops and feeder vibration stops or is safe

question.zh: RS-1 急停时飞达座是否断电？
question.en: Does the RS-1 E-stop cut power to the feeder bank?

zh.criterion: 拆装飞达、更换料管前须关闭开关（手册安全说明）；关闭后无振动
zh.method: 按手册操作验证

en.criterion: Switch off before removing feeder or changing tube (Manual safety section); no vibration when off

zh.criterion: 机身或料道附近有“取料区禁止伸手”或等效警示标识
zh.method: 目视

en.criterion: "Keep hands clear of pick-up area" or equivalent label on the body or near the lanes

question.zh: 机身是否有安全警示标签？内容和语言？
question.en: Is there a safety label on the body? Text and language?

zh.criterion: 外露边角无锐边毛刺；手柄与取料区无夹手风险
zh.method: 手套触摸检查

en.criterion: No sharp edges or burrs; no pinch risk at handlebar or pick-up area

zh.criterion: S-JVF02 SMT 振动（料管）飞达
zh.method: 核对铭牌与订单
zh.source: 手册 封面 p.1；§3 p.6

en.criterion: S-JVF02 SMT stick (tube) vibration feeder

zh.criterion: JUKI RS-1 飞达座
zh.method: 核对订单 / 实机装入

en.criterion: JUKI RS-1 feeder bank

zh.criterion: 24 V DC
zh.method: 核对铭牌 + E01 实测

en.criterion: 24 V DC

zh.method: 核对铭牌 + E02 实测

zh.criterion: 直流供电，无电源频率要求；振动频率由旋钮可调（具体范围待确认）
zh.method: 核对 + C05 结果

en.criterion: DC supply, no mains frequency requirement; vibration frequency adjustable by knob (range TBD)

question.zh: 振动频率可调范围是多少（Hz）？
question.en: What is the adjustable vibration frequency range (Hz)?

zh.method: 核对 C06 / C07 结果

zh.criterion: 66 mm 料管；4 条独立料道
zh.method: 核对 C01 结果

en.criterion: 66 mm tube; 4 independent lanes

zh.criterion: 英文操作手册（Rev. 2025）、合格证、本检验表、装箱单齐全；防静电袋 + 防震泡棉包装，手柄与料道固定
zh.method: 对照装箱单核对
zh.source: 手册 封面（Rev. 2025）；包装 G-PAK-01

en.criterion: English Operation Manual (Rev. 2025), conformity certificate, this checklist and packing list included; anti-static bag + foam, handlebar and lanes secured

question.zh: 随机文件清单和包装方式（防静电袋 + 泡棉）是否正确？
question.en: Are the document list and packing (anti-static bag + foam) correct?
